scope: One new PHASE_ONLY EVENT head on H union V; all producers, PAIR, context refiners and normalizers remain frozen. This is not a full TRAIN40 producer refit.
reason: Smallest coherent extension of the already prepared family, using more upper-stage TRAIN without swapping parents under an old head
selection_dependency: Review current official candidate status first; do not tune this recipe from test12 scores

roles.H: 8 historical refiner/head-training groups; becomes final head TRAIN
roles.V: 8 exposed development groups; proposed conversion to final head TRAIN only after authorization
roles.FCWD_Dev32: Exclude from fit and model selection; already exposed transfer
roles.test12: Exclude from fit; private TTC not accessed; new predictions/export need separate scope

stacking.reason: H features derive from refiners trained on H; no claim that H or H+V residuals estimate generalization
stacking.cross_fitting: Not performed and not implied; group cross-fitting would require rebuilding fold-specific dependent stages under a different plan
stacking.normalizers: Retain frozen historical H normalizers; no fitting on test or transfer; bind their hashes through parent freeze

model.initialization: fresh seed7; zero final output; do not continue old trained head

objective.mass: Preserve original group-balanced training mass: 1/(number_of_TRAIN_groups * queries_in_group). Recompute across H+V; do not concatenate separately normalized mass vectors. Evaluation band weights 0.5/0.3/0.1/0.1 are not training weights.

budget_proposed_only.source: New authorization only; no V18 remainder

checkpoint.endpoint: fixed final update; no early stopping on H/V/test
checkpoint.resume: Exact identity only; count replayed updates; refuse existing historical destinations

export.format: TorchScript head plus metadata and five fixed TRAIN examples
export.parity: CPU FP32 same examples, max absolute TTC error <=1e-5 s; disclose any exception before proceeding

stages.operation: Bind explicit new authorization, plan SHA256 and CPU/update budget
Verify full frozen genealogy and no changed producer/normalizer; never replace a failed binding
Verify both caches; join by frozen IDs; disjoint groups; recompute TRAIN masses; seal union
Fresh PhaseOnlyAnchor EVENT seed7 with frozen input semantics
Apply declared sampler, optimizer, scaled schedule and durable checkpoints
Export head and verify fixed TRAIN examples; no benchmark inference or submission

training_adapter.authorization: Separate post_v18_refit_authorization_v1 receipt with authorized=true, exact plan_sha256, user_instruction_reference and budget equal to budget_proposed_only. None created by this review.
training_adapter.resume: Same command plus --resume. Exact plan, source, environment and authorization identity. A stale RUNNING.lock requires manual inspection; no automatic restart.
training_adapter.resource_guards: CPU only, one thread, RSS checked before each batch. Wall time reserved conservatively in durable 60-second slices, including resumes. Cooperative guards, not OS-enforced hard limits; an operation can overshoot a slice.
training_adapter.validation_limit: Actual caches and hashes checked; synthetic checkpoint/resume/export tests use zero optimizer steps. End-to-end optimization has not been executed.
